name: @forgesworn/forgemoji
description: Original familiar Unicode emoji artwork by TheCryptoDonkey for ForgeSworn. Bundle locally, without a graphics service.
author: TheCryptoDonkey

scripts.build: node scripts/build.mjs && node scripts/build-vectors.mjs && node scripts/build-gallery.mjs && node scripts/build-vector-review.mjs
scripts.build:svg: node scripts/build-vectors.mjs && node scripts/build-gallery.mjs && node scripts/build-vector-review.mjs
scripts.rebuild:vectors: python3 scripts/reconstruct-vectors.py && node scripts/optimize-vector-masters.mjs && npm run build:svg
